message: No detected input validation: The code reads CSV files and selects columns by name but performs no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the incoming data.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read from a local filesystem path provided via CLI argument; no remote source is used, so no checksum, authentication, or integrity verification is present or applicable.

No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool; labels are simply derived by shifting the daily return column.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation pipeline applies column selection, feature engineering, and MinMax scaling but contains no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious input samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code constructs models via RegressorModels (scikit-learn regressors trained from scratch) and does not load any pretrained serialized model weights, so no hash check, signature verification, or controlled-source loading is implemented or needed — but no integrity verification exists.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks label distribution, class balance, or anomalous training samples before or during training; labels are simply extracted and passed to models.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no backdoor or trigger detection mechanism such as neural cleanse, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or any robustness stress tests are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of held-out test set isolation enforced programmatically, signed/hashed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation; train/test splits are date-windowed but no integrity controls exist.
No detected input sanitization: The code reads CSV files and passes them through preprocessing without any explicit shape, range, or schema validation before feeding data to the regression models.
No detected output bounds checks: There are no checks on model prediction outputs for NaN values, out-of-range predictions, or any sanity bounds before results are stored or returned.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses tabular regression models (not an LLM), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
